summary: Implemented T063: per-pool experiment manifests, multi-pool run identity, validation gates, and one-command rerun. The package reports/ (kept at the location the previous Developer chose) owns RunMetrics + LedgerSnapshot + CoverageSummary + decisions checksums (from the pre-existing metrics.py), the ExperimentManifest dataclass with per-pool invariant and dataset / schema / code / dependency revisions, the RunIdentity for multi-pool runs, the validation layer enforcing required fields, report checksum, numeraire / qualification agreement and per-pool invariant, and a rerun entry point that reconstructs events / strategy / model bundle from the manifest and reproduces the metrics + decisions checksums byte-identically. Added a rerun-manifest CLI subcommand and the corresponding tools/check_imports/layer_map.py entry so the import-graph gate stays green. The candidate ships 35 new tests in tests/test_reports_t063.py covering the per-pool manifest, checksum tamper detection, missing-required-field gates, numeraire / qualification disagreement, multi-pool one-manifest-per-pool under one run identity, byte-identical rerun, no-overwrite of a prior run, and the no-USD-presentation of a RELATIVE_ONLY run guard. The contract dependencies (T061 backtest, T062 strategy baselines) and the dependency edges stay untouched; no docs / Spec / task-contract / workflow / dependencies surface was edited.

residual_risks: The reports package is located at src/robinhood_lp/reports/ (the previous Developer's location); ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2 row 6 names the package robinhood_lp.backtest.manifest. The layer-map classification was set to 'backtest' so the import-graph gate is satisfied; if Owner wants the package renamed to robinhood_lp.backtest.manifest a follow-up PROPHET move is required (this Developer cannot edit the architecture or task contracts).

The reference RunMetrics.compute_run_metrics uses a placeholder zero IL/LVR proxy and a fee-revenue-as-proxy total return; the proxy is recorded on the metrics record so the manifest can carry the slot but a downstream reviewer should not interpret the value as a true LVR measurement. A T093 follow-up is expected to bind the gas-price oracle.

The rerun reconstruction supports the published baseline strategy kinds (HOLD / BROAD_RANGE / FIXED_WIDTH / VOLATILITY_WIDTH / OUT_OF_RANGE_REBALANCE) and the canonical model bundle (constant liquidity, static fee, flat gas, zero slippage, deterministic failure, fixed latency). A model bundle with a different model kind would fail reconstruction; the manifest's bundle_version is recorded so the failure is observable. A full rerun-fidelity matrix is left for a later task.

Pre-existing ruff F841 / B905 findings in metrics.py (the previous Developer's draft) are now resolved; the metrics.py file still contains the simpler-than-ideal _decision_in_range_segments placeholder that filters by payload 'decision_kind' rather than by stage — kept as-is to avoid scope creep into the strategy layer.

Two pre-existing test failures remain on the base commit (test_abi_artifacts forge dependency, test_documentation_citations storage.schema). They are not introduced by T063 and are listed only for reviewer transparency.
